HrR স্যারের সম্পর্কে গ্রুপে তেমন ভাল ভাবে রিভিউ পাওয়া যায় না।যা আছে তা সবি  নেগেটিভ এন্ড ফানি পোস্ট।সেজন্য আমিও খুবি বিভ্রান্ত বোধ করেছিলাম।তবে যতটুকু বুঝেছিলাম উনি সবার কাছে খুবি বাজে ফ্যাকাল্টি । সুতরাং আমিও তাই জানতাম।
 তবে কিছু সত্যি কথা বলতে চাই।স্যারের কিছু পজিটিভ এন্ড নেগেটিভ দিক আছে।আমি মনে করি দুই দিকটা বললেই সবার উপকার হবে।
নেগেটিভ : স্যার এর পড়া বুঝতে  কস্ট হতে পারে  অনেকের।স্যার এর পড়া আপনার কাছে অনেক সময় বোরিং লাগতে পারে।স্যার ক্লাসে টুকটাক ম্যাথ দেন করতে।তবে স্যারের প্রশ্ন গুলা অনেক সময় হার্ড হয়ে থাকে।যেমন আমার কথা বলি,স্যার কুইজ গুলা ইজি নিছিলেন(স্যার যা পড়াইছিলেন)বাট মিড এ প্রশ্ন করেছিলেন অনেক বেশি হার্ড।স্যার মিডে আমাদেরকে বলেছিলেন, ৩০ এ ২০ পেলেই আমি খুশি।এন্ড স্যার এত বেশি হার্ড করেছিলেন যে মেক্সিমাম ১০ এর নিচে পেয়েছিলেন।
স্যার ৩টা কুইজ নিলে ৩টাই কাউন্ট করেন।৪টা নিলে ৩টা।এন্ড স্যার ৩-৪টা এসাইনমেন্ট দেন।অনেক সময় এসাইনমেন্ট এর ভাইভা নিতে পারেন আবার নাও পারেন।
পজিটিভ :- স্যার খুবি ফ্রেন্ডলি - হাসিখুশি মানুষ।ক্লাসে প্রশ্ন করে আপনি কখনো অপমানিত হবেন না।স্যার অফিস টাইমে আমাদের আসতে হাসি মুখে বার বার বলতেন।

• AUZ( Phy107 ): Auz sir is arguably one of the most if not the most professional teacher I've interacted in NSU. He will start and end the class on time and utilise all the time and behaves exactly how a teacher should behave or control the class. He follows classroom rules very strictly which includes coming to class on time and not being punctual towards them is the only way you can be in trouble. He doesn't talk about anything extra or unnecessary but the classes never get boring if you are interested in physics in general.
His teaching style is as proper as it gets. The lectures are in plain simple english which is quite easy amd comfortable to understand. I've personally had a lot of good physics teachers during my O/A level days and I could say he is one of the best teachers to go to understand physics.
Sir will take 4-5 quizes and might count all or n-1 of them. His question patters are pretty straightforward in all of the exams and following the class notes and lectures should be enough.
Finally, I dont think so he curves much/at all which might be the reason he has some bad reviews. But he surely will give you deserving grade. He is very good for learning and questions are pretty straightforward so getting a good grade with proper efforts if you properly follow his guidelines wont be much difficult.
•MS1( MAT130) : MS1 sir isnt someone extraordinary or someone who's teaching style is magnificent but I could assure you its adequate and I think thats all you need. He uses his handwritten notes and simply explains from them. Sir is very easygoing and  he is moderately good for learning.
MAT130 itself is a moderately difficult course due to so many variation of formulae and identity cases. There's no point if you dont understand the techniques of the math. Even if you know how to do it, on a bad day you might mess up your maths. However the question pattern MS1 sir provides its pretty easy and if you understand the chapters, you will be able to answer with ease.
Sir's question pattern is very easy and he provides partial marking more than he can. This results in no point of curving. Still sir will give you opportunities to score some bonus marks which will help to curve your grade.
•AHBB( EEE111) : This semester(spring2023) sir took this course for the first time. I honesty dont know where to begin on how much of a nightmare this was. EEE111 is an extremely important course for all EEE students and it can be very tricky and complex and really needs someone to explain it you a bit properly. 
There is no good way to put how bad his teaching style is. He uses his touchpad and tried to explain the concepts without even clearing any of the basic terminologies. He doesnt provide any proper lectures and the classnotes that you might take down are absolutely trash to understand. Its also not quite understandable what he says as his english isnt as proper as you would expect. He also said he doesnt count attendance in the first class and as I was not understanding anything from his class I started being irregular and tried to study on my own through YT. However he still counted 5 marks for attendance which was unexpected. Still I consider that as my mistake but it doesnt change the fact he is extremely poor for learning and this course requires a lot of that.
Even if he curves a lot, there's no point of curving if you can't properly write anything in your answer scripts. If you get AHBB id highly suggest to drop immediately if you dont want your money to go waste.
•MSRH (EEE154): Another nightmare me and my coursemates faced.
EEE154 isnt that hard of a course and can be learned through youtube lectures as well. However I wouldn't say MSRH sir is bad for learning but he is quite moderate.
However the nightmare begins when it comes to grading and assessments. He didnt give enough time during exams. 1hour was never to complete so many drawings. Sir even took the final exam on a day where it overlaps with exams of your other courses and you'll have to adjust with another section if your timings clash. Ill share my grades as an example. I had 40/40 from all the quizes and including the mid. After the mid my laptop broke and everything was suppose to be done in Autocad so I couldnt put in much practice.However I still sat for all the next exams and even if all of them were bad i still cant figure out how bad it could be for me to fail the course. Yes i had full marks up until and including my mid and I ended up with an F after my finals.This 1cr course seriously demotivated me a lot.He is extremely poor for grading.If you dont want a good grade Id suggest drop MSRH immediately. 
The reviews were just my unbiased opinion of how felt during classes with them. Feel free if to write if you have your opinions too. See less
